## Summary / 改动摘要

Describe what changed and why. / 请说明修改内容和原因。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] Core tests pass / 核心测试通过
- [ ] New behavior has tests or an explanation / 新行为有测试或说明
- [ ] Documentation is updated / 文档已更新
- [ ] UI changes were checked on desktop and mobile when applicable / 涉及界面时已检查电脑和手机

## Security and privacy / 安全与隐私

- [ ] No credentials, production data, real names, internal URLs, screenshots, databases, or logs are included
- [ ] 未包含密钥、生产数据、真实姓名、内部地址、截图、数据库或日志
- [ ] Third-party code includes source and license information / 第三方代码已注明来源和许可证

## Screenshots / 截图

Only attach fully anonymized screenshots. / 只能附加彻底匿名化的截图。
